Alphabet's net income rose about 12.1% from fiscal Q1 2024 to fiscal Q4 2024. Q4 is not reported directly, so I derived it from the full-year and nine-month figures (USD millions).

- **Q1 2024 net income:** $23,662 million (from the Q1 2025 10-Q's prior-year column).
- **Q4 2024 net income:** FY2024 net income of $100,118 million minus nine-month 2024 net income of $73,582 million, which is $26,536 million.
- **Change:** (26,536 − 23,662) / 23,662 = 2,874 / 23,662 ≈ 12.15%.
